lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Fourth floor, the desk by the third window. Your card is dead, the terminal is dark, and the drawer is not locked because nobody has ever locked a drawer in this building.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: My own file. Eleven years, four commendations, and a note from the fourth year saying I ask too many questions about counterparties.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: And an addendum, dated the day I ran, in a hand I do not recognise: QUERY ORIGINATED WITH SUBJECT. NO PRIOR REQUEST ON RECORD.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Nobody asked me to look. That is what it means. For two hundred and eighty-one years nobody asked, and then I did, on my own, on a Tuesday.
